title: Novel prevention insights into depletion of oxidative stress status through regular exercise and grape seed effective substance in heart ischemia rat model.
authors: Zarei, Safar; Taghian, Farzaneh; Sharifi, Gholamreza; Abedi, Hassanali
one_liner_zh: 该文研究运动与葡萄籽提取物对心肌缺血大鼠氧化应激的预防作用，仅提及锌指转录因子GATA4和MAPK3蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Myocardial ischemia (MI) is recognized as the most frequent cardiovascular disease which is the dominant cause of global morbidity and mortality. Artificial intelligence tools and integrative data analysis revealed superoxide dismutase, catalase, glutathione peroxidase, gap junction protein alpha, myosin heavy chains, and zinc finger transcription factor GATA4 are engaged in oxidative stress and in cardiomyopathy. Network analysis indicated that MAPK3 might be the highest distribution property and cut point in this network, which could be a potential candidate for preventing and treating oxidative stress in heart tissue. Among antioxidant agents, grape seed extract (GSE) is an effective substance that altered antioxidant status in heart tissue. Considering drug discovery methods, we illustrated that GSE might target the MAPK3 protein with sufficient binding affinity. Moreover, we found that low- and moderate-intensity training might prevent the depletion of antioxidants after MI. GSE consumption altered the levels of superoxide dismutase, glutathione peroxidase, and catalase after 14 weeks. Therefore, the interaction of low- and moderate-intensity training and GSE had a synergistic effect on the antioxidant status and relative expression of the Mapk3. Moreover, the interaction of high-intensity training and GSE had a compensatory mechanism that could scavenge reactive oxygen species and improve endogenous antioxidants and modulate the Mapk3 level in MI rats. Consequently, we displayed positive influence and synergic effects of simultaneous GSE prescription and regular physical activity for 14 weeks to prevent acute and chronic heart ischemia cardioprotective phenomenon. Furthermore, the capacitation oxidative stress and relative expression of the Mapk3 was significantly increased by GSE and regular exercise.
abstract_zh: 心肌缺血（MI）被公认为最常见的心血管疾病，是全球发病率和死亡率的主要原因。人工智能工具和整合数据分析揭示，超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶、间隙连接蛋白α、肌球蛋白重链和锌指转录因子GATA4参与氧化应激和心肌病。网络分析表明，MAPK3可能在该网络中具有最高的分布特性和切割点，这可能是预防和治疗心脏组织氧化应激的潜在候选靶点。在抗氧化剂中，葡萄籽提取物（GSE）是一种有效物质，可改变心脏组织的抗氧化状态。考虑到药物发现方法，我们证明GSE可能以足够的结合亲和力靶向MAPK3蛋白。此外，我们发现低强度和中等强度训练可能防止心肌缺血后抗氧化剂的耗竭。GSE摄入在14周后改变了超氧化物歧化酶、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶和过氧化氢酶的水平。因此，低强度和中等强度训练与GSE的相互作用对抗氧化状态和Mapk3的相对表达具有协同效应。此外，高强度训练与GSE的相互作用具有代偿机制，可清除活性氧、改善内源性抗氧化剂并调节心肌缺血大鼠中的Mapk3水平。因此，我们展示了同时给予GSE处方和规律体育活动14周对预防急性和慢性心脏缺血心脏保护现象的积极影响和协同作用。此外，GSE和规律运动显著增加了氧化应激能力和Mapk3的相对表达。
